h1: Loan and Credit Line Tax Savings Calculator
subtitle: Find out whether the interest on a home equity loan, credit line or investment loan is deductible, how much it saves in federal and state tax, and what the borrowing really costs after tax.

The use of the money decides deductibility, not the type of loan. Home equity debt spent on a car, a vacation or other debts is not deductible.

$

Interest is deductible on up to $750,000 of home debt in total ($375,000 if married filing separately).

$

Taxable interest, ordinary dividends and short-term gains, less investment expenses. The deduction can't exceed it.

Your 2026 taxes
%

Applied only when you itemize. Use 0 if your state has no income tax or doesn't allow the deduction.

$

Mortgage interest on your other home debt, state and local taxes (after the cap) and gifts to charity.
